name: Nawazuddin Siddiqui Chup Bilkul Chup (Gangs of Wasseypur)
visual_description: Nawazuddin Siddiqui with a mustache putting his index finger to his lips demanding silence, with subtitle 'Chup... Bilkul Chup'.
usage_context: Used to aggressively silence someone who is speaking nonsense, giving unsolicited advice, or talking too much.

example.top_text: When a relative starts talking about your marriage plans

text_areas.description: Situation or person needing to be silenced immediately
